intents.text:
Rishabh's [COVID-19 Decision Support System](/projects/covid-decision-support) is an IoT-enabled, two-stage diagnostic pipeline that combines patient vitals, symptoms, and chest X-rays. 

- Stage one uses sensor data and symptom checklists for a preliminary assessment.
- Stage two adds chest X-ray or CT analysis for a deeper diagnosis.

- Free LLM tiers use smart fallbacks across providers, with Redis atomically managing budgets and rate limits. 
- You can read more about it in the blog post [How the AI agent on this site works](/blog/how-my-portfolio-agent-works).
